info.title: Remuda Hub HTTP
info.description: Device-authenticated Hub REST and WebSocket upgrade routes. JSON-RPC over `/v1/node` and `/v1/follow` is documented as GET upgrades.

post.summary: Persist a Hub-supervised SSH host and start preflight/reconnect

201.description: Host registered; inspect state and lastError while connecting

post.summary: Mint a single-use Node enroll token (D-018)
post.description: Requires an authenticated device. The plaintext is returned once; the Hub stores only its Argon2 hash. The device pairing access code never enrolls a Node.

delete.summary: Remove a supervised SSH host after stopping its instances; keep journal history

204.description: Supervisor cancelled, connection closed, registration removed; remote files retained

get.summary: List acknowledged Node workspaces, including cached roots while offline
get.description: Human and Bot operator credentials only; Agent callers receive 403. Mutations prepare and commit on the Node; HTTP success requires settlement, journal persistence, and updated host projection.

post.summary: Register an absolute project directory after Node validation
post.description: Human and Bot operator credentials only; Agent callers receive 403. Mutations prepare and commit on the Node; HTTP success requires settlement, journal persistence, and updated host projection.

delete.summary: Unregister a directory without deleting files or stopping sessions
delete.description: Human and Bot operator credentials only; Agent callers receive 403. Mutations prepare and commit on the Node; HTTP success requires settlement, journal persistence, and updated host projection.

get.summary: Fresh diagnostics over the registered host's active Node link
get.description: Requires device authentication. Runs the Node inventory, data/identity, disk and listener checks without returning credentials. Login states are local-marker heuristics. RPC callers cannot choose filesystem paths.

200.description: Host preflight, including blockers in exitCode/checks
Instance page. lifecycle is derived from Node journal observations (requested→starting→running→exited/failed). activity=idle only after a herdr/Node idle observation, never the create default.

422.description: PLACEMENT_UNSATISFIABLE when host availability or placement constraints cannot be satisfied; PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED when explicit gateway delegation has no matching provider profile. Unspecified or direct delegation may use native authentication without a provider profile.

reasons: no gateway provider configured for host <id>; add a provider or choose native

delete.description: Removes the Hub record (journal, commands, interactions, fleet membership) and asks the owning Node to purge its per-instance data directory. The agent's own native transcripts under the user's home are never touched. Human and Bot devices only; agents receive 403. A live Instance is refused with 409 unless `force=1`, which stops it and settles it as `exited` first. A repeated delete returns 404, so the call is idempotent.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: `force=1` stops a live Instance before deleting it.

post.summary: Mint a credential bound to an agent instance
post.description: Requires Human origin. The returned credential always has Agent origin and cannot be rebound to another instance.

post.summary: Continue an exited Claude session on a new instance (D-026)
post.description: Creates a new Instance on the same host and workspace whose driver launches `claude --resume <nativeSessionId>` with the parent's provider, permission and model settings. The exited instance keeps its history and stays exited. Human/Bot only; Agent callers get 403. Idempotent per (instance, mode) inside a short window.

409.description: No resumable native transcript, transcript too old, or host offline

post.summary: Stage one image for a later instance.send (D-027)
post.description: Raw image bytes with a Content-Type. Human or Bot devices only; an Agent-origin caller is refused. The media type is sniffed from the bytes and must agree with the declared Content-Type. Limits: 5 MiB per attachment, 64 MiB staged per instance, 4 attachments per send.

parameters.name: instanceId
parameters.description: Instance this attachment is staged for; it also scopes who may read it back.

get.description: Used by the Node to materialize an attachment before dispatch, and by the UI to re-display one. Authorized either as the Node hosting the object's instance — a Node cannot read another host's attachments — or as a Human/Bot device. Expired objects read as 404.

200.description: Raw image bytes, served as an attachment with nosniff

get.summary: List git worktrees on a host (Node remuda worktree catalog)

post.summary: Create a git worktree on a host (`git worktree add -b wt/<name>/…` from main) at the Node's fixed `../remuda-wt/<name>` location

200.description: Per-instance fan-out results with an accepted/failed summary

CallerInstance.name: x-remuda-instance-id
CallerInstance.description: Narrow a device credential to an existing instance with Agent origin. Cannot promote or rebind a scoped credential.

AgentApproval.name: x-remuda-approval-id
AgentApproval.description: Retry an action after Human approval with its interaction ID. The grant is single-use and bound to the exact caller and action.

AgentActionConflict.description: Human approval required, or an action conflict. For HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, a Human must answer the Interaction with allow-once before retrying the exact action with x-remuda-approval-id.

target.description: SSH config alias or user@host, resolved by the Hub system SSH client.

labels.description: Placement labels such as egress:gateway or region=sg.

origin.description: Authenticated origin; clients must treat an unknown origin as Agent.

children.description: Direct children created by this instance; descendants do not inherit scope.

token.description: Bearer credential; keep secret and do not journal it.

nodePurge.description: Outcome of the Node `instance.purge` call; the Hub record is deleted either way.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Instance creation uses PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED for an explicit gateway request without a matching provider profile and PLACEMENT_UNSATISFIABLE for unsatisfied placement constraints.

ProviderModel.description: One catalog entry. `enabled` is what New Session may offer.

ProviderModelInput.description: A model id, or a structured entry. Bare strings migrate to enabled entries.

ProviderDiscover.description: Probe a gateway before the profile exists. The token is used once and never echoed.

token.description: Auth token for an unsaved profile. Never returned.

profileId.description: Reuse this saved profile's stored token, base URL and headers.

defaultModel.description: Must be one of the enabled models.
Must be one of the enabled models.
Must be one of the enabled models.

workspaceId.description: Canonical target workspace for a mutation

path.description: Absolute path on the Node, within its configured workspace roots

mode.description: structured keeps the parent's driver; terminal continues the same native session in claude-pty so the conversation gains a terminal tab.

prompt.description: Optional first prompt delivered to the resumed session.

replayed.description: True when an earlier resume for this (instance, mode) was reused instead of launching again.

parentInstanceId.description: Immutable creator instance, recorded by the Hub from authenticated identity.

lifecycle.description: Derived from Node lifecycle observations in journal.append. Create default is requested, not running.

activity.description: idle only after a Node/herdr agent_status or session idle observation. Create default is unknown.

mode.description: How this instance reached its kind. "promoted" means a terminal instance had a known agent CLI take over its PTY foreground (D-025); the driver stays shell-pty.

promotedAt.description: When the terminal was promoted. Absent unless mode is "promoted".

nativeSessionId.description: Native session id the driver reported; what POST /v1/instances/{id}/resume passes to `claude --resume` (D-026).

nativeTranscriptPath.description: Native transcript path, when a driver reported one (D-026).

resumedFrom.description: Exited instance whose conversation this instance continues (D-026).

worktree.description: Worktree name created by remuda worktree create.

workspaceId.description: Registered workspace containing the repository; omitted selects the Node default.

AttachmentUpload.description: Staged attachment metadata (D-027). The media type and name are the Hub's own: the type is sniffed from the bytes and the name is derived as <objectId>.<ext>, so a caller-supplied filename never survives.

digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stored bytes.

expiresAt.description: RFC3339. Staging is lazily expired, not swept by a job.

FleetBroadcast.description: Select running instances and fan one command out. Requires `all` or at least one of `hosts` / `labels` / `kinds`; filters intersect. Agent broadcasts are checked before dispatch; cross-instance sends and all key input require Human approval.

all.description: Forbidden from Agent origin, even with filters. Human/Bot callers must also set confirm=true.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation of an all broadcast; does not exempt Agent callers.

idempotencyKey.description: Base key; each instance is queued under `<key>:<instanceId>` so a retry replays instead of double-sending.
